subject: Regional maintenance rebalancing & fixed monthly remuneration proposal
messages:
From: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@acme.io>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.io
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: regional maintenance rebalance + monthly remuneration for pilot

Sergio,

Thanks for taking a look. We're planning a phased regional rollout of our agent cluster in Q4 which will require expanded maintenance windows in us-west for two weekends in October and November to complete migrations. The work is low risk but will temporarily reduce our effective p95 availability for that region by ~0.6–0.9% during the change window.

Before we move forward we'd like to request:
- A temporary exception that rebalances the maintenance window carveout for us-west for Oct/Nov, explicitly excluding those scheduled windows from the uptime calculation; and
- A fixed monthly remuneration (service credit) during the pilot months to account for the operational uplift and to make our internal procurement sign-off easier.

We attached a short maintenance plan (Acme_Maintenance_Plan.pdf) and a proposed schedule. Ideally we can agree to a capped fixed credit rather than a token-by-token percentage so finance can book it.

Can you confirm Redwood's process for this type of exception and what level of detail you need for the carveout and reporting? If acceptable, we'd like a short-term amendment for Oct–Nov with a one-month review in December.

Cheers,
Tom Hargrove
Director of Platform Operations
Acme Cloud

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@acme.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: regional maintenance rebalance + monthly remuneration for pilot

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear note and the plan. We're happy to work a pilot amendment for Oct–Nov. High level:

- Exception pathway: Redwood can create a temporary "scheduled-maintenance carveout" for the us-west region that excludes explicitly scheduled maintenance windows from the monthly uptime calculation. We will need exact UTC windows and a final schedule at least 10 business days before each maintenance event.
- Remuneration model: rather than a percent-of-usage token credit, I propose a fixed monthly remediation fee for the pilot (easier for your finance) with a cap and a single-line amendment to your contract.

I've attached a quick calculator (remedy_calc.xlsx) and suggested options:
A) Fixed monthly cap: $5,000/month for Oct & Nov (Redwood issues invoice credit applied against monthly usage).
B) Tiered fixed: $3,000/month base + $1,500/month per additional scheduled weekend above 1 (capped at $7,000).

Operational triggers we'd expect to document:
- Confirmed maintenance windows (start/end UTC)
- Post-maintenance verification checklist (basic health checks + KV-cache warmup success)
- Reporting cadence: Redwood will provide a one-page post-maintenance summary within 48 hours that includes observed p95 and any incidents.

Laura / Ben — tagging you for pricing impact and legal-redline path. Tom — if that structure seems reasonable I'll draft the amendment language and a one-page SOW for the two-month pilot.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: remedy_calc.xlsx (calc, suggested caps and example amortization)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@acme.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: regional maintenance rebalance + monthly remuneration for pilot

Sergio — thanks for the quick proposal. A few internal notes and requests before we send a formal amendment:

- Pricing: Ben, can you confirm margin impact for Option A ($5k/mo fixed) vs Option B (tiered)? My expectation is Option A is simplest for both parties and predictable.
- Legal / Contract: we'll need to make the carveout explicit: list maintenance windows by UTC timestamp; carveouts apply only to scheduled windows provided in writing 10 business days in advance; any unplanned downtime remains in scope for standard SLA remedies. Also include an explicit end-date (Nov 30, 2026) and a clause for a single 30-day extension by mutual written consent.
- Reporting/Verification: Ops wants Redwood to include the raw p95 numbers and the rolling 30-day calculation used for the uptime in the post-maintenance summary. That will be narrow (single CSV export) and should be fine.

Tom — if you're aligned with those constraints please confirm the exact UTC windows and whether Acme prefers Option A or Option B. I'll standby to draft an amendment and loop Legal for a redline.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@acme.io>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: regional maintenance rebalance + monthly remuneration for pilot

Laura / Sergio — appreciate the options. Acme prefers Option A (fixed $5,000/month) for Oct & Nov, capped as you suggested. We can confirm the UTC windows below:

- Oct pilot: 2026-10-09T22:00:00Z to 2026-10-10T06:00:00Z
- Nov pilot: 2026-11-13T22:00:00Z to 2026-11-14T06:00:00Z

We agree to provide the final maintenance schedule 10 business days ahead; the post-maintenance summary requirement is fine. For reporting we'd like a short CSV export and a one-page summary delivered to ops@acme.io and tom.hargrove@acme.io within 48 hours.

Also, can Redwood explicitly state the post-maintenance verification checklist in the amendment (startup success criteria, KV-cache hit-rate > 90% within the first 30 minutes, and no more than one incident classified as P1)? If we see any of those breach conditions in the pilot, we'd expect the fixed credit for that month to apply.

If you can draft a one-page amendment and SOW with the language above we can get procurement sign-off quickly. I'll upload the schedule and a short runbook to this Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_maintenance-plan

Thanks — Tom
Director of Platform Operations | Acme Cloud
